source.paper: D'Addezio et al. FoodEx2 Harmonization of the Food Consumption Database from the Italian IV SCAI Children's Survey. Nutrients 2024, 16, 1065.

purpose: Paper-derived DMT candidate-recall and classification tests for FoodEx2 base-plus-facet construction in a food-consumption/dietary-survey context, not monitoring-domain gold codes.

scoring.base_recall: Expected base code appears in candidate retrieval.
scoring.facet_recall: Expected facet descriptor codes appear in candidate retrieval.
scoring.facet_family: Facet descriptor is attached to the correct facet type.
scoring.construction: Final constructed code matches the paper example or an explicitly accepted alternative.
scoring.validation: Constructed code passes the FoodEx2 validator or reports clear domain/context reasons.
